configurePresets.name: sly2-base
configurePresets.description: NativeEE (engine/) as the source tree, this repository's games/ as the title directory. The build dir is OUTSIDE the repository: it receives the extracted ELF and the recompiled code (game-derived, never committed). NOTE: CMake reads presets from the SOURCE dir, and the source dir here must be engine/ -- so these presets are documentation of the cache variables build.sh passes; use ./build.sh (cmake --preset cannot re-root the source directory).

configurePresets.name: sly2-disc
configurePresets.description: Your own disc image: NATIVEEE_DISC from the environment (or -DNATIVEEE_DISC=...). The ELF is extracted and SHA-256 gated at build time.

configurePresets.name: sly2-elf
configurePresets.description: The loose ELF (SCUS_973.16): NATIVEEE_TITLE_ELF from the environment (or -DNATIVEEE_TITLE_ELF=...), hashed at configure time.
